text: Plan: inspect the existing design documents before proposing changes, then seed docs/SPEC.md and, if an OpenSpec workspace exists, per-capability Given/When/Then requirements under openspec/specs/. Preserve the independent 500 mA brief, distinguish requirements from ASSUMED defaults, and record every budget. Key risks are the strictly below 2 mA unloaded-current budget, current-limit tolerances and source capability, manual-assembly/footprint suitability, and the below USD 8 BOM target. Keep firmware explicitly not applicable and physical validation outstanding; this stage does not modify the schematic or PCB.
